applicabilityBasis.summary: FILQ-A represents the accumulating Class 1 ACC shares of Fidelity USD Digital Liquidity Fund, a segregated portfolio of Fidelity International Strategies Funds SPC. The September 14, 2026 prospectus describes tokenized mutual-fund equity interests, NAV-based dealing and accumulation of net income in the share price. These fund-share rights support the securities exclusion in GENIUS Act section 2(22)(B)(iii), independently of yield or reserve composition.

genius.notes: Reviewed as tokenized fund-share equity, with no GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization asserted. The official issuer PDF endpoint returned HTTP 403; the issuer-authored September 14, 2026 prospectus text was independently reopened through the linked Jina retrieval mirror. Cayman fund registration and manager or distributor licensing are not token-specific GENIUS permissions. This fund is distinct from Fidelity Digital Assets National Association's FIDD.
